title: Did the NES Really Use 8‑bit Chips?

scenes.text: The NES was built on 8‑bit technology, right?

scenes.label: NES 8‑bit
scenes.text: Everyone thinks the NES ran on an 8‑bit chip.

scenes.label: 6502 + Extras
scenes.text: The NES actually used the MOS 6502, a 8‑bit CPU, but its custom Ricoh 2A03 added 6‑bit sound and 9‑bit graphics counters.

scenes.label: Beyond 8‑bit
scenes.text: So the NES had more than just a plain 8‑bit brain.
Follow to stay ahead of the tech curve.

description: Think the NES was just an 8‑bit console? Think again. Discover the hidden layers of its architecture. Follow for more retro tech myths busted!
